_about: The Instagram Saves database. Property names and types are fixed: the tool writes to these names. Category options come from your config.json categories plus Other.

properties.name: Name
properties.about: the first line of the caption, or 'Save by @author'

properties.name: URL
properties.about: the link to the post on instagram.com

properties.name: Media ID
properties.about: Instagram's id for the post, used so nothing is added twice

properties.name: Caption
properties.about: the caption, up to Notion's 2000 character limit

properties.name: Posted
properties.about: when the creator published it (Instagram does not share when you saved it)

properties.name: Why saved
properties.about: one line: what makes this one worth keeping, read from the caption

properties.name: Idea
properties.about: one line: a post of your own this could spark
